LanguageData.SSC_CombatOverdrive.label: combat overdrive
LanguageData.SSC_CombatOverdrive.description: Unleash the final combatant's potential: melee damage ×1.30, melee cooldown ×0.75, ranged cooldown ×0.80, incoming damage ×0.75, movement speed ×1.25, and pain ×0.50 for 1 in-game hour. Combined with final passive bonuses, this specialization gives incoming damage ×0.60 and melee cooldown ×0.6375. Ranged cooldown does not affect the interval between shots within a burst.\n\nManually cast on self; visible and usable only while drafted. Undrafting after activation does not cancel the buff. The 4-hour cooldown starts on activation. Personality extraction or replacement removes the buff; it does not transfer with the personality.
